## 3. Plain wording and structure

- `Thread refs/pi/threads/45: since 2026-11-12T07:01:35.000Z` becomes `Continuing the conversation on #45 (started 12 Nov, 3 earlier runs)`. A new thread gets `Starting a new conversation on #45`.
- `refs/pi/worktrees/45: new on origin` becomes nothing, or `No saved working tree yet` in debug.
- `Running pi agent for: <task>` becomes the turn header in section 1, so it includes who asked and links to the comment.
- Fold each turn into its own `::group::` so a long run stays readable. The single-line turn summary stays outside the group, so the collapsed view reads like a timeline.
- Failures (`pi execution failed`, timeouts, rejected pushes) stay `::error::` / `::warning::` annotations, so they show up in the run summary page.

## 4. Job summary

`deps.summary` is used today only for notifications and the "how to read the thread" block. It could also get a small table per run
